caption: The video depicts a close, slightly high-angle view of a rusty, soot-stained metal tabletop holding a large shiny-metal pot, with a single tubular leg visible at right over a concrete floor. From the left, a gloved hand holds a yellow-and-black power tool whose working tip is pressed against the tabletop along the front base of the pot. White smoke or steam rises from the contact zone and drifts right, partially veiling the pot. Dark burnt patches and scattered grit cover the surface. Across the clip the tool's tip traverses along the front edge of the pot's base from left-centre toward the right, while the tool body shifts from a downward-angled position at the left to a more horizontal stance crossing the top of the frame. The smoke plume fluctuates in density, billowing more heavily through the later frames. A bright reflection sits steadily on the pot's curved surface. The green-gloved arm at the lower left grows into a large blurry mass occluding much of the left frame, while the tabletop under the tip shows progressively more of a lighter scraped patch.
relations: As the tool tip traverses the pot's front base from left toward right, the scraped patch beneath it widens progressively.
The tool body tilts from a downward-angled stance to a more horizontal one as the tip advances.
White smoke rises from the contact zone and drifts right, billowing more heavily in later frames.
The green-gloved arm at lower left expands into a blurry mass occluding much of the left frame.
